title: What do you think of the mobile UI of our AI RPG?
author: fluffy_the_sixth
selftext:
We are creating a text-based roleplaying game and recently updated our mobile layout for an upcoming early access. And would love some feedback from the community on its look and feel!

We really want the UI to feel more like you are playing a game than using an app, but still remain intuitive and not too intrusive.

Thank you! You can check us out at [nopotions.com](http://nopotions.com)

comments.author: Josvdw
comments.body:
I gave Coplay your image and tried to 2-shot the creation of this UI in Unity  
[https://screen.studio/share/2G8JJiLU](https://screen.studio/share/2G8JJiLU)

comments.author: Toastti
comments.body: In general it looks good but you should move up the buttons and prompt higher on the page. Having them so far down on the bottom will get in the way of the swipe up to go home behavior on phones. And nothing's more annoying than trying to interact with an app and it closing because the buttons are so far down.

replies.author: fluffy_the_sixth
replies.body: Thanks! Great point, we are also in the process of adding some contextual options that shows up alongside the game messages so that you don't always have to use the buttons / input at the bottom.

comments.author: Comprehensive-Ship-7
comments.body:
Very clean, nice asthetic.   
  
In Inventory, Instead of small buttons that limit action like "use" and "equip", consider just tapping on it and having a context menu of context available actions for that item, like "use", "drop", "equip", etc.

replies.author: fluffy_the_sixth
replies.body: Glad you like it, we are in the process of adding more contextual options and info like rarity and stats to the inventory menu as well.

comments.author: ash_mystic_art
comments.body: Very nice! My main suggestion is to make sure to test it on smaller screens like iPhone 12/13 mini. Some of those buttons look rather small and close together. They may be difficult to tap on small s teens, especially buttons at the very top or bottom of the screen.

replies.author: fluffy_the_sixth
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! We will make sure to test the layout on smaller mobile screens!

comments.author: interestingsystems
comments.body: This looks great. AFAIK no other game in your space has this level of graphical polish, so it's a great way to stand out. Looking forward to trying it out!

replies.author: fluffy_the_sixth
replies.body: Thanks so much! That made my day!

comments.author: UAAgency
comments.body: Looks very non modern tbh, has a bit of an outdated vibe... maybe try another font? It's hard to read as well
